clue.title: The Star of Luxor
clue.text: Whitfield has chartered the steamer Star of Luxor, cargo 'scientific instruments', to sail on Thursday's tide.

clue.title: The night express
clue.text: Adler has a private compartment and a sealed luggage van on the Alexandria night express, and a ship waiting there.

clue.title: Four trucks of machine parts
clue.text: Bellini has applied for a permit to take four trucks of 'machine parts' out of Cairo on the coast road, and is waiting for it to be signed.

clue.title: Three days
clue.text: Every export of antiquities from Cairo is stopped for three days: the ports, the railway, every checkpoint. Only the old south road is unguarded, and the thieves will have to take it.
